title: 2021 Topps Series 1 #290 Josh Harrison Washington Nationals
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2021 Topps Series 1 trading card featuring baseball player Josh Harrison from the Washington Nationals. The card number is 290 and it is part of the 2021 Topps set manufactured by Topps in the United States. This sports trading card is a collectible item for fans and collectors of Major League Baseball memorabilia.
